notes.title: Bug fixing
notes.content:
Thanks for everyone that is playing the demo while the Fest is still UP, i gathered some very useful feedback to improve the game further!

I fixed many bugs and you can download the new versión right now:
- Fixed bug with the discord link, now you should be able to join through the game and through the store page.
- Fixed some enemy bugs
- Did some rebalancing to enemies and sword damage of Eko.

And many more... Stay tuned for future updates!

notes.title: NEW DEMO RELEASE
notes.content:
Eko and the Bewitched Lands is participating on the Steam Replayability Fest! Come and enjoy the new Demo version with a lot of Quality of Life improvements and bug fixes!

What this version includes:

 Brand new Map
 Some new abilities and remake of others
 Rebalancing difficulty
 Tons of bug fixing

notes.title: Request access to the playtest NOW!
notes.content:
We are glad to announce the first ever playtest of our game! 

About the playtest
This test is mostly focused on performance and gameplay feel.

Features

 Combat system
 Two weapons (bow and sword)
 Two worlds (dungeon and forest)
 8 Enemies


After a few months of development the first playtest demo is ready, it's in a very early stage but we wanted to let you try it and start gathering feedback to improve it further.
